quarterly_data.signal: Subsidiary Changxinsheng (Wuhan) signed a long-term agreement with an existing overseas customer (name withheld as a trade secret) to sell a package of optical fiber and cable related products from signing through December 31, 2030. No fixed total; estimated sales about RMB 450,000 ten-thousand excluding tax, about 178% of 2025 audited revenue; the agreement sets prices, minimum total sales quantity commitments and delivery. The company will buy the products from outside suppliers in batches and expects to book revenue on a net basis (gross profit only), so it does not expect a material effect on 2026 or later results.
